parent_objective: design no-PPO objective-only probe after objective-readiness synthesis

public_gates: M885 must define objective-only update scope and trust region
M885 must define exact objective and replay retention gates
M885 must define interpolation and rejection rules
M885 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor parameters in M885
do not train M761 residual-head parameters

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_objective_update: design no-PPO enriched pair-delta objective probe

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, PPO, promotion, or learned driver claim
stop_condition: stop if exact objective gates are undefined
stop if replay retention gates are omitted
stop if train/eval/holdout discipline is unclear
stop if design admits PPO directly
fallback_plan: if design is complete, pre-register objective-only probe implementation
if gates are too weak, route to gate design
if corpus caveats dominate, route to source generation
if branch cadence is reached, synthesize before continuing
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M884 promoted from objective-readiness to objective-probe branch

hypothesis: A small no-PPO objective-only probe can be designed from the M883 exact objective without risking immediate proof washout, provided the design uses strict exact-objective, interpolation, replay-retention, and no-promotion gates.
success_criteria: M885 defines trainable scope and trust region
M885 defines exact objective non-regression and improvement gates
M885 defines replay and behavior retention gates
M885 defines interpolation and rejection rules
failure_criteria: M885 trains actor or residual-head parameters
M885 ignores exact objective or replay retention
decision_rule: M885 may only design the objective-only probe. It must not train, run PPO, promote, or claim objective update usefulness.
next_blocker: Enriched pair-delta objective-only probe has not yet been designed
